sources.title: Artemis IV
supportedClaims: Artemis IV is planned as the first Artemis mission to Gateway.
Published schedule and architecture details remain subject to revision.

sources.title: Gateway: About
supportedClaims: Orion is planned to deliver Lunar I-Hab to Gateway during Artemis IV.
Gateway's initial elements include HALO.

sources.title: Gateway Capabilities
supportedClaims: Gateway will operate in a near-rectilinear halo orbit around the Moon.
NASA describes the orbit period as approximately 6.5 days.

sources.title: NASA's Artemis IV: Building First Lunar Space Station
supportedClaims: Orion is planned to transport I-Hab to lunar orbit and act as its tug.
The crew is planned to dock I-Hab to HALO and activate Gateway.

sources.title: A 15-Year Near-Rectilinear Halo Orbit Reference Trajectory
supportedClaims: The published engineering reference is a southern L2 9:2 lunar-synodic-resonant NRHO.
The reference has an average period of 6.562 days and published perilune-radius range of 3,196 to 3,557 kilometers.
The reference is idealized and generic rather than an Artemis IV spacecraft ephemeris.

sources.title: A Robust Navigation Design for NRHO Rendezvous
supportedClaims: NRHO rendezvous may be described in relative local-vertical/local-horizontal coordinates.
The report supports operational concepts, not an exact Artemis IV rendezvous ephemeris.

sources.publisher: NASA/JPL Navigation and Ancillary Information Facility
sources.title: Deep Space Gateway NRHO SPK label
supportedClaims: The generic DSG reference platform uses NAIF target ID -60000.
The distributed trajectory is stored relative to Earth and spans 2020 through 2035.
The file can contain microsecond-scale data gaps.

sources.publisher: NASA/JPL Navigation and Ancillary Information Facility
sources.title: 15-year Deep Space Gateway NRHO reference SPK
supportedClaims: Supplies the generic DSG reference platform state for offline sampling.

sources.publisher: NASA/JPL Navigation and Ancillary Information Facility
sources.title: DE440s planetary ephemeris SPK
supportedClaims: Supplies the Earth and Moon states required to transform the Earth-relative DSG SPK into a Moon-centered state.

sources.publisher: NASA/JPL Navigation and Ancillary Information Facility
sources.title: NAIF leap-seconds kernel 0012
supportedClaims: Supplies the locked time-system conversion used to record human-readable source epochs.

selection.method: Successive Moon-centered radius minima selected from the generic reference SPK; fixed ET bounds make regeneration deterministic. The dates are a source-segment choice, not Artemis IV mission dates.

referenceTrajectory.disclaimer: Official idealized Gateway reference trajectory; this is not an Artemis IV flight trajectory or prediction.
